content.comment_body: I'm receiving an error when trying to connect [product_name] controller to my laptop. I'm using [product_name] software [version_no] and running Windows 10. The controller is connected correctly via IP address, but the error still appears. Could you recommend any changes?

Hello [user_name], I'm not completely sure if I'm interpreting the message right, but doesn't it suggest restarting [product_name] software? Does the error remain after you've restarted? Regards, [user_name]

Dear [user_name], The error continues to show even after restarting [product_name] software. I'm using [product_name] [version_no] and Windows 10. This issue occurs when I try to upload a program from the controller to the PC. However, when I use another laptop with Windows 7 and the same software version, I'm able to upload the program successfully. Is [product_name] [version_no] not compatible with Windows 10? Regards, [user_name] [user_name]
To clarify, only [version_no] of [product_name] software is designed for Windows 10. Previous versions weren't released for use on Windows 10.
How can I fix the error when uploading the program from the controller to my laptop?

Hi, Try the following steps: 1. Close any other software running on your PC. 2. Connect [product_name] directly to your PC using a cable (avoid using a router or switch). 3. Disable all other Ethernet connections except for the connection to [product_name]. 4. Restart your PC, launch [product_name] software, and try again. If this doesn't resolve the issue, go to: c:user/<Your user name> and delete the folder .[product_name][version_no] This folder will be recreated with default settings the next time you start [product_name] software. Good luck.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing a compatibility or operational issue when trying to upload a program from a [product_name] controller to a PC using [product_name] software [version_no] on Windows 10. Uploading works on Windows 7 with the same software version, indicating the problem may be system-related or due to configuration conflicts. Basic troubleshooting does not resolve the issue, suggesting it may be a recurring or less obvious problem for some users on Windows 10.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to upload programs from a [product_name] controller to a PC using [product_name] software [version_no] on Windows 10 without encountering errors, as they can on Windows 7.
